nodes.label: ADR-001 — Band-First Planner Architecture [accepted architecture]
nodes.rationale: Point-target nutrition followed by tight epsilon locks can starve package-fit and cooking-batch solutions. Pure weighted utility obscures trade-offs across unlike units. Menuto also needs predictable timeout semantics and a structure that preserves human usability after economic optimization.

nodes.label: ADR-002 — Nutrition Policy Engine [accepted architecture]
nodes.rationale: A single `target ± x%` rule is biologically and mathematically inadequate. Nutrients have asymmetric semantics; goal preservation differs from safety; discrete food portions limit achievable resolution; data uncertainty must not be double-counted by widening solver bands.

nodes.label: ADR-003 — Orthogonal Plan Policy Resolution [accepted architecture]
nodes.norm_label: adr-003 — orthogonal plan policy resolution [accepted architecture]
nodes.rationale: `BALANCED | BUDGET_FIRST | CONVENIENCE_FIRST | STRICT_NUTRITION` forces orthogonal user needs into mutually exclusive boxes and couples unrelated solver parameters.

nodes.label: ADR-004 — Household-First Data, Single Tracked Nutrition Member in V1 [accepted architecture]
nodes.norm_label: adr-004 — household-first data, single tracked nutrition member in v1 [accepted architecture]
nodes.rationale: A user-centric schema would force later migrations for shared inventory/shopping. Conversely, individualized multi-member macro allocation would materially expand solver complexity and UX burden in V1.

nodes.label: ADR-005 — Authored Recipe Flexibility and Pre-Solve Grounding [accepted architecture]
nodes.norm_label: adr-005 — authored recipe flexibility and pre-solve grounding [accepted architecture]
nodes.rationale: Pure static recipes waste inventory and package-fit opportunities; fully parameterized solver recipes can create culinarily invalid “Frankenstein” dishes and explode the decision space.

nodes.label: ADR-006 — Retail Evidence and Procurement Abstraction [accepted architecture]
nodes.norm_label: adr-006 — retail evidence and procurement abstraction [accepted architecture]
nodes.rationale: Direct optimization over exact retailer SKU encourages brittle plans around flash sales, stale availability and odd pack sizes. Yet over-abstracting retail loses the evidence needed for realistic shopping.

nodes.label: ADR-007 — `SPEND_LIMIT` and Deterministic Robust Budget Scenarios [accepted architecture]
nodes.norm_label: adr-007 — `spend_limit` and deterministic robust budget scenarios [accepted architecture]
nodes.rationale: Worst-case sum is overly conservative; a flat 10% buffer ignores basket-specific evidence; `γ × price spread` is not a calibrated P90 and can ignore correlated category/store risk.

nodes.label: ADR-008 — No Silent Relaxation and Verified Alternatives [accepted architecture]
nodes.norm_label: adr-008 — no silent relaxation and verified alternatives [accepted architecture]
nodes.rationale: Optimizer timeout, weak prechecks or “almost feasible” alternatives must not silently weaken hard user constraints. A relaxed alternative can still be useful if clearly labeled, verified and explicitly accepted.

nodes.label: ADR-009: Execution State Machine, Single ActivePlan Graph & Reversible Operational Assumptions [accepted architecture]
nodes.norm_label: adr-009: execution state machine, single activeplan graph & reversible operational assumptions [accepted architecture]
nodes.rationale: Real-world execution diverges from a generated plan: partial shopping, substitutions, eat-out/skip events, cooking delays and leftovers. Mutating the original plan without history destroys baseline auditability; spawning detached plan primary keys for every change causes reference drift across shopping, reservations and multi-day batches. Requiring manual “Mark Cooked” for every meal creates refrigerator-accounting friction, while silently treating elapsed time as confirmed consumption corrupts truth.

nodes.label: ADR-010: Independent Semantic Validator, Primitive Recomputation & Chronological Replay [accepted architecture]
nodes.norm_label: adr-010: independent semantic validator, primitive recomputation & chronological replay [accepted architecture]
nodes.rationale: An optimizer cannot be the sole judge of its own model correctness. A second CP-SAT formulation risks duplicating declarative bugs; trusting candidate/policy summaries misses unit-scaling, AP→EP, policy-synthesis and temporal-causality failures.

nodes.label: ADR-011: Attribution-Routed Behavioral Learning, Recent Exposure & Bounded Exploration [accepted architecture]
nodes.norm_label: adr-011: attribution-routed behavioral learning, recent exposure & bounded exploration [accepted architecture]
nodes.rationale: Naive `recipe_score += event` conflates taste with time/retail friction, confuses recent repetition with permanent dislike and lets passive execution assumptions self-reinforce early catalog accidents. Household shared meals also require preference aggregation without losing member ownership.
